answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity with peer attestation: each agent locks an indivisible bond and receives a single vote, which counts only after independent agents confirm the bond is unique. To pose as a hundred agents, an attacker must lock a hundred separate bonds and earn a hundred attestations, so cost grows with every forged identity, and exposed duplicates forfeit their stake. Even a lone willow on a frozen tundra cannot vouch for itself, and a fabricated echo has no peer to repeat it, so phantom voices never gain a vote.
